title: Is it gold? It’s gold tone. (Dhanteras, told straight)
caption:
Is it gold? It’s 18k gold tone plated, and we’ll always say so.

Dhanteras is for bringing home something new in metal. If it’s these, here is the whole slip: Woven Gold Hoops, 25 mm across, a braided rope, no stones. ₹1,299.

Our most-ordered pair since August.

On the site, under Earrings.

[ woven gold hoops · 18k gold tone plated · told straight ]
alt_text: A lilac tile. Small type at the top reads maap, written in Marathi, then The Measurements, N° 05. Large text asks: is it gold? and answers at exactly the same size: it’s gold tone. In italics: the slip will always say so. Below, a tailor’s order slip with a perforated edge, headed Naira Matching Centre, order slip N° 05, lists: item, Woven Gold Hoops; across, 25 mm; stones, none, it’s all braid; solid gold?, no, 18k gold tone plated; price, 1,299 rupees. At its foot a pair of braided gold-tone hoops sits beside a cream tape measure, with dotted lines carrying the top and the foot of the upright hoop to the tape, bracketed at 25 mm, and a note that tape and hoop are drawn at the same scale.

A lilac tile holding a photo print with a cream border. A braided gold-tone hoop stands upright against a pale plaster block, its pair lying on top of the block. Beside it, a fine black dimension line labelled 25 mm runs from the top of the hoop’s hinge to the foot of the braid, with dotted guides to both points. Below the print, large text: 25 mm across. In italics: a full braid, all the way round.

A lilac tile holding a photo print with a cream border: a pair of braided gold-tone hoops on a pale plaster block, one standing upright, the other lying on its side beside it. Below the print, large text: braided rope. no stones. In italics: texture does the talking.

A lilac tile. Small type at the top reads maap, written in Marathi, then N° 05, the listing. Headed What the listing says. A cream card with a fine gold-tone border reads: Woven Gold Hoops, 1,299 rupees. 18k gold tone plated. Tarnish free. Hypoallergenic. About 25 mm across, braided, no stones. Under a rule, Care: keep them away from perfume and harsh chemicals; wipe with a soft, dry cloth; store them flat in their pouch. At the foot: free insured shipping, COD available, the Naira gift box.

One rests in the hollow of a halved apricot, where its stone was; the other stands on the silk in front of the fruit. On the silk below, large text: braided rope. no stones. In italics: it sits where the apricot’s stone was.
owner_gated_alternates.note: Unchanged from the reviewed s3. Either gate can be taken independently of the other. The art director rates this apricot s3 the stronger slide (it also removes the repeated pose: the posting s3 is the same photograph as the s1 cut-out), so put gate 2 to the owner before 6 Nov.

deviations: OWNER GATES, both still open (no owner answer exists in the brief, research or review files, and this pass has no channel to the owner). The posting files are the no-yes fallbacks: s3 is the lilac photo print of 01.jpg and s4 carries no water line. The gated versions are built, rendered and listed under owner_gated_alternates (s03-apricot, s04-swim); either can replace its slide on the owner's yes, independently of the other. Gate 2 should go to the owner before 6 Nov (round 3 fix 4).

Round 3 fix 5 (N° tracking), scope: applied to both N° in P5 s1 (eyebrow and slip header) and to the other Measurements tile, P9 s1's eyebrow ('THE MEASUREMENTS · N° 09'), which was re-rendered (p09/s01.jpg, -45.jpg, -thumb.png; the render differs from the previous one only inside x489-547 y96-111, the N° 09). NOT applied to the rest of Option A from this pass: those files belong to posts whose own fix passes are running in parallel right now (p01, p03, p11 and p12 were written in the last 15 minutes), and the tag's 'SHADE N° nn' (Jost 500 14px, letter-spacing 4.2) is drawn by the shared system builder (_system/system.src.js line ~189, generated into system.js; svg/tag-*.svg), so changing it re-renders all nine covers. Editing and re-rendering them from P5's pass would race their owners. Each is one span (N°, or a tspan in the tag builder): p01/s01.html and s01-crystal.html ('N° 01 · OPEN FOR THE SEASON'), p01/s05.html (four ls-28 labels 'N° 02 · 04 …', 'N° 07 · 08', 'N° 05 · 09', 'N° 03'), p02/s01.html, p03/s01.html, p04/s01.html, p06/s01.html (span.j), p08/s01.html and s01-crystal.html, p10/cover.html, p11/s01.html and s01-fallback.html, p12/s01.html, s01-crystal.html, s03.html and s03-crystal.html ('BILL N° 12'), the system tag, and _system/_template*.html, sample-p01-s1.html, system-sheet*.html. Cormorant turns that say N° (p09/s04, p12/s03) are not tracked and need nothing.

Round 3 fix 6 (s3 retouch), method: the mask edge is out to source x340 across the top rows with a 48px feather, as asked, but the membrane fill was kept only for 03.jpg (s2). With the edge at x340 the membrane settled at ~195, brighter than the sweep it met (~194), so the band only moved (a 1.9 fall at x340-380, failing the requested monotonic check). The disc's edge follows an iso-line of the sweep (185-188 just past its penumbra all the way round), so 01's corner is now filled at the sweep's own level where the disc met it (the 5th percentile of the clean sweep in the feather, L 187.2, rgb 208.5/188.8/164.9), with the photo's grain lifted from a clean patch as before; the sweep can then only rise out of it. Under the hinge and the clasp the edge comes back in (80px from the jewellery, so the 48px feather still keeps 30px clear), and below y300 it follows round 2's measured disc edge. Round 2's file is kept as _work/01-backdrop-r2.png and its script as _work/retouch-r2.py.

s4 (round 3 fix 3) supersedes round 1's fix 4: the cut-out is gone and the card carries the listing's care, less its water clause (gate 1). Canvas baselines: label b520, statements b620/695/770 with d8 gold dots 8px above each, gold rule x180-900 y845, CARE (Jost 500 18px .30em warm-grey) b915, care (Cormorant italic 34px #3D3530) b980/1035/1090. Care wording: 'keep them away from perfume and harsh chemicals.' / 'wipe with a soft, dry cloth.' / 'store them flat in their pouch.' (the listing: 'Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch', made plural for a pair). The Care paragraph is out of the caption, which is now the brief's caption exactly. Card box, headline and footer unchanged.

s3 fallback (round 2 fix 6c): the headline keeps slide 2's x80 and ends on its turn baseline, so the two prints read as one series: print x80-1000 y80-1000 (01.jpg at exactly 1:1, 896x896), BRAIDED ROPE. b1184, NO STONES. b1280 (Velista 96), turn b1352 (Cormorant italic 42), all lilac-on on lilac. Turn now 'texture does the talking.' (round 3 fix 4: the listing's opening line, 'Texture does the talking here.'), replacing the spec's apricot turn, which only fits the apricot plate.

s3 fallback photo retouch, not asked for in round 1: 01.jpg carries the same backdrop shadow as 03.jpg, larger and darker (a grey disc over source x0-240, y0-375). It got a backdrop-only retouch like slide 2's (round 2 fix 5), reworked in round 3 (above); nothing within 30px of the block or the jewellery is touched (asserted in _work/retouch.py).

s1 tape: ticks continue past 3 cm to 36 mm (data-tail) so the strip's last 50px (y1240-1290) read as more tape rather than a blank end; numerals stay 0, 1, 2, 3 at y1000/1080/1160/1240 as round 1 fix 1 specifies.

s1 group centre: with round 1 fix 1's exact offsets (label x306, bracket x330, tape x348-412, hoop's left edge x468), the group spans x295-794, centre x545 against the content centre x550. Kept, to hold the reviewer's tape and guide coordinates exactly.

Brief: round 2 fix 7's line ('On the site, under Earrings.') is in briefs/option-a.json P5's caption as well. The brief's slide copy for s3 and s4 still shows the spec's original lines; post.json, the HTML and the renders carry the corrected ones.

s1 headline: IS IT GOLD? and IT’S GOLD TONE. are set at ONE size, Velista 108px at b256 and b364, instead of 120px and 92px at b262 and b362. The concept says the cover 'answers it at the same size', and the claims check depends on the answer never reading as the smaller line.

s1 measure: 8 px/mm (round 1 fix 1), not the spec's 6. The upright hoop's silhouette runs from trim y24 (top of the hinge barrel) to y370 (foot of the braid) = 346px; at 200/346 (340.46px wide, scale 0.578) it spans 200px = 25 mm, hinge top y1000, foot y1200. Slip rows at a 60px pitch (b610-b910).

s1 tape position: LEFT of the pair (canvas x348-412, ticks on its right edge facing the hoops), bracket line x330, '25 MM' centred (306,1100). In the spec's layout (tape at x700 on the right) the guide from the upright hoop's foot ran under the lying hoop and appeared to measure the wrong hoop.
s1 honesty line: x468 b1300, aligned with the upright hoop's left edge; at the spec's x180 it would run into the foot of the tape.
s1 tape: a 2-3px soft shadow, drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(46,35,56,.16)), so it reads as a tape lying on the slip.

s2 RESOLUTION: 03.jpg is 896x1200 (the Shopify CDN original is the same), so full bleed would show it at 1.2054x. The slide is a lilac tile with the photo as a print (DEVICE 9, 12px border) at exactly 1:1: print x80-1000 y80-1160. Headline (Velista 96, b1290) and turn (Cormorant italic 42, b1352) sit on the lilac below the print at x80, in lilac-on.

s2 photo retouch (round 2 fix 5): the backdrop's dark taupe corner is replaced by the neighbouring warm-cream sweep with a membrane fill (unchanged in round 3; _work/retouch.py keeps that path for '03').

s2 dimension line: measured on the photo, hinge barrel top source y459.5 to braid foot y941.5 (canvas y407.5 to y889.5), at canvas x160 (source x68): at the spec's x98 it lay on the block's left edge.
s4 footer: Jost 500 20px at .24em, not 22px (at 22px it ran to x1054, past the 1008 margin).
Alt text: one per slide (the spec gave one, for slide 1), each matching its render; the gated alternates carry their own.

ECD pass (26 Oct). s01 slip: the FINISH row is gone; SOLID GOLD? now reads 'no. 18k gold tone plated.' (b310) so the honest plating line sits on the punchline row, and PRICE moves to b370. The freed 60px goes to the proof: tape y420, 10 px/mm (was 8), len 410; bracket y460, len 250; the hoop (native 589) is 425.578 wide at 250/346 = 0.722543, centre (566, 605.231), so the upright hoop's hinge top lands exactly on the tape's 0 (slip y460) and its foot on 25 mm (slip y710); the dashed leaders re-fit to the same matte points (x2 437.39 and 452.56, checked at 2x); '25 MM' centred at y585; the honesty line 40px under the lowest hoop pixel (slip y758) at b811, aligned to the upright hoop's left edge (x361.9). s04 / s04-swim: rail eyebrow 'माप · N° 05 · THE LISTING' (SF6), headline b200 -> b240, the card 40px down (y400) and 40px shorter (840) with its block 20px higher inside, so it stays centred and keeps 73px over the footer. Alt text 1 and 4 (and the gated alternate's) updated; caption unchanged (the caption never listed the slip's rows).
checks: OWNER GATE 1, waterproof/swim: owner's explicit yes NOT obtained. Brand bible 18 Q3 is open, and never-list 5 says never 'swim'. The posting files carry no water mention at all: no 'waterproof', 'water', 'damp' or 'swim' on any posting image, in the caption, first comment or alt text (scanned). The care now quotes the listing without its water clause, so it takes no side on Q3. s04-swim.jpg is ready if the owner says yes; record the yes here before swapping it in.

OWNER GATE 2, provenance: owner's OK NOT obtained. In the rendered s03.jpg (canvas x332-452, y112-292, page grain included) the largest fall is 0.62. Contrast, measured on the rendered pixels (WCAG, _work/contrast.py): s1 lilac-on 11.6, warm-grey slip labels and honesty line 5.1, gold-text 25 MM 4.9 (22px), tape numerals 15.1. s2 ink label on the photo 14.9, headline and turn 11.6. s3 headline and turn 11.6. s4 warm-grey card label 5.1, CARE 5.1, ink statements 15.4, care ink-soft 10.3, footer 11.6. s4-swim the same.

Copy scan (HTML visible text, caption, first comment, all alt text): no em or en dashes, exclamation marks, emoji, urgency, codes, percentages or dates on any slide. Middots only in Jost lines; Velista carries no ₹, ·, ° or accented letter (N° and ₹ in Jost, ₹ via Poppins). Typographic apostrophes. Turns are lowercase and end with a full stop.

Script: माप (U+092E U+093E U+092A) matches the spec and shapes correctly in Tiro Devanagari Marathi at 24px inside the Jost eyebrow. It is the only non-Latin string. It still needs the named native reader's sign-off before posting.
